title: Terminal section transport for a triangle of schemes
statement: For schemes R, S, T [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], maps e:S to R, t:T to S and k:T to R with t followed by e equal to k, and a sheaf of sets H on R [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], define the isomorphism from terminal sections of k inverse image H to sections of t inverse image of e inverse image H on the base change of the terminal etale object of S. Its data is the inverse of equality transport along the triangle equation, followed by the inverse of the chosen inverse-image composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] evaluated at the terminal object of T, followed by contravariant restriction along the second-projection isomorphism from the pullback of the identity of S [def-pc-fibre-product].

lean.statement: def etaleSetTerminalTransport {R S T : Scheme.{u}} (e : S ⟶ R) (t : T ⟶ S) (k : T ⟶ R) (hk : t ≫ e = k) (H : Sheaf R.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) : ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback k).obj H).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 T))) ≅ ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback t).obj ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback e).obj H)).obj.obj (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ t).obj (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 S))))
